title: School years, Kathmandu
description: Went through my school years in Kathmandu. Loved physics and math the most — classic first signs of an engineering student.

title: SEE (School Leaving Certificate)
description: Sat the SEE exams. Decided early that engineering was the direction.

title: +2 Science — NEB
description: Completed +2 in the science faculty (Physics, Chemistry, Maths). Spent evenings watching construction sites and sensor tutorials — couldn't stop asking how things are built.

title: Pulchowk Campus, IOE
description: Cleared the IOE entrance and joined Pulchowk Campus, Institute of Engineering. First semester of the BE program began — and the real journey started here.

title: First engineering notes published
description: Started structuring my notes for Engineering Geology, Surveying and more. Built this website to keep the knowledge organized and share it publicly.

title: Projects & first videos
description: Working on course-driven projects and recording short videos that explain the concepts I'm studying — one semester, one subject at a time.

title: Building in public
description: Every note, project and video on this site is a checkpoint on the same journey I invite you to follow along with.
